title: Freshdesk Ticket Summary
summary: Summarise each new Freshdesk ticket in three bullets and add it as a private note for the agent who picks it up.
seoTitle: Auto-Summarize Freshdesk Tickets with AI Private Notes
answer: This template runs when a new Freshdesk ticket is created, reads the subject and description, generates a three-bullet AI summary highlighting the customer's issue, context, and any action items, then posts the summary as a private note visible only to support agents. The summary helps agents triage and respond faster without reading long ticket descriptions.

faq.a: Freshdesk does not include built-in AI summarization. It offers canned responses and macros, but those do not auto-generate context-aware summaries from ticket content. This template uses a custom LLM agent to create instant summaries.

faq.q: Are the summaries visible to customers?
faq.a: No. The summaries are added as private notes, visible only to support agents in your Freshdesk workspace. Customers never see them.

faq.q: How fast does the summary appear after a ticket is created?
faq.a: The Freshdesk automation rule triggers the webhook immediately on ticket creation. The AI summary typically completes in 1 to 3 seconds, and the private note is written back within 5 seconds total.

faq.q: Can I customize what the summary includes?
faq.a: Yes. Edit the ticket-summarizer agent instructions to change the summary format, tone, or content. You can ask for more bullets, sentiment analysis, urgency flags, or specific topics to highlight.

faq.q: What happens if the API call to Freshdesk fails?
faq.a: The HTTP step retries up to 3 times with exponential backoff. If all retries fail, the error appears in run history. The ticket remains in Freshdesk without the summary note, and you can manually rerun the playbook.

sampleOutput: Private note in Freshdesk: AI Summary: Customer cannot log in after password reset. Tried clearing cache. Using Chrome on Windows. Action: Check password reset flow and verify email delivery logs.
whatYouNeed: Freshdesk account with admin access, Freshdesk API key, Freshdesk automation rule configured to call webhook on ticket creation
failureHandling: The HTTP step retries up to 3 times with exponential backoff (250ms initial delay). If Freshdesk webhook validation fails, Ballet rejects the request. If summarization or note posting fails, the run appears in history with error details.
nativeVsTemplate: Use Freshdesk canned responses if you need pre-written replies. Use this template when you want AI-generated summaries tailored to each ticket's content, saving agents time on long or complex tickets where reading the full description slows triage.

secrets.name: FRESHDESK_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Shared secret used to verify inbound Freshdesk webhooks (HMAC-SHA256).

secrets.name: FRESHDESK_DOMAIN
secrets.description: Your Freshdesk subdomain, for example `acme` for acme.freshdesk.com.

secrets.name: FRESHDESK_API_KEY
secrets.description: Freshdesk API key (used as the Basic auth username).

secrets.name: FRESHDESK_API_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Basic auth password. Freshdesk accepts any value, for example `X`.

setup: Publish the playbook and copy its webhook URL from Studio.
In Freshdesk, create an automation rule on ticket creation that calls the webhook with the ticket fields.
Create a test ticket and watch the run in Studio.
